channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Cloudflare Impact reaches $100 million in donations
item.description: This week, Cloudflare's Impact programs will reach $100 million in donated services. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Cut your AI spend with AI Gateway's Auto Router
item.description: Cloudflare AI Gateway now features a model router that evaluates request complexity using an edge-deployed classifier to select the optimal model. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Introducing cf: the agentic CLI for the entire Cloudflare API
item.description: We are releasing cf, our new command-line tool that mirrors the entire Cloudflare API and supports programmatic TypeScript configuration. We are also open-sourcing Forge, our internal SDK generator. (2 sources: cloudflare, javascriptweekly)

item.title: Four months of VoidZero at Cloudflare: making the open-source JavaScript toolchain faster for all humans and agents
item.description: Since joining Cloudflare, VoidZero has delivered more than 80 releases that drastically speed up JavaScript compilation, linting, and testing. (2 sources: cloudflare, javascriptweekly)

item.title: EmDash 1.0: the stable CMS with a secure plugin registry
item.description: EmDash 1.0 is a stable, open source CMS built for Astro, with agent-friendly workflows, secure sandboxed plugins, and a decentralized registry that keeps publishers in control. (2 sources: cloudflare, javascriptweekly)

item.title: Detect and send production issues straight to your agent
item.description: You can now use built-in error monitoring in Cloudflare Workers to group production failures and send stack traces, logs, traces, and application context directly to a coding agent to investigate further and open a pull request. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Simplifying domains for people and agents
item.description: Cloudflare Registrar’s new search delivers fast, transparent results across 420+ extensions using Workers, Durable Objects, and WebSockets. Its expanded API and cf CLI also let agents search, register, and transfer domains. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Monetization Gateway beta: charge AI agents for consumption with HTTP 402
item.description: Cloudflare’s AI Gateway, Ceramic.ai, Stocktwits, and more are using the Cloudflare Monetization Gateway today to charge agents for access to tokens, APIs, and MCP tools. U.S.-based sellers can now apply for access to the closed beta. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Pay Per Use: when AI uses your work, you should get paid
item.description: Pay Per Use is now in beta. AI companies report when they use publishers’ content, and Cloudflare handles billing, payouts, and reporting, so our customers are paid according to use. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Agents Refactor 300K Lines in Three Weeks, and Practitioners Ask What It Proves
item.description: CodeScene has published a case study in which coding agents refactored 300,000 lines of C over three weeks for roughly $4,000 in tokens, verified by a frame-by-frame replay harness. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Developer policy update: Transparency, state policy, and what’s ahead
item.description: Explore GitHub’s latest transparency data and learn more about policy updates affecting developers and open source. The post Developer policy update: Transparency, state policy, and what’s ahead appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: Helping personal agents shop more intelligently and reliably with Link
item.description: As agents take on more purchases, agent builders have increasingly asked us to help agents navigate checkout and earn consumer trust. Today, we’re sharing three major improvements to support this broader set of needs. (1 source: stripe)
